proposals.evidence: Platts p. 120 identifies bārish rain as a Persian abstract noun from bārīdan. The existing Hindi bariś attestation supplies a supported whole regional donor for these baris/bariś responses. This does not conflate the separate Indo-Aryan baras/varsā rain/year family. Exact source form bʌɾiʃ is preserved. The donor locality is an attestation, not an assertion of historical transmission from that village.
